findings.title: Service start token reads were outside the debug scope
findings.symptom: Readiness accepts existing but disabled Debug. Initial StockAcceptance.start called the base native process read and HeldProcess token read without enabling it.
findings.source: scm_acceptance_worker.py:508 and scm_stock_git_lifecycle.py:127 read the LocalService process token. Cross-account OpenProcessToken requires enabled SE_DEBUG_NAME.
findings.consequence: A supported disabled token can reach SCM RUNNING and then fail token inspection before the WMI scope.
findings.remedy: Root wrapped super().start() and HeldProcess in inspection_privilege and added eight state/failure fixtures.
findings.verification: Real Acceptance.start AST replay with injected OS operations now succeeds for initially disabled/enabled tokens: one scope, native/held reads enabled=True, original state restored. Source fixtures36 passed/no skips.
